queries:
SELECT t.tradekind,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS proportion
FROM advancedbehavior ab
INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind;
SELECT tradekind,
       COUNT(*) AS trader_count,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trader), 2) AS percentage
FROM trader
GROUP BY tradekind;
SELECT tradekind,
       COUNT(*) AS trader_count,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trader WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL), 2) AS percentage
FROM trader
WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY tradekind;
SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.abhvreg) AS abhv_count
FROM advancedbehavior ab
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind;
SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT a.translink) AS transaction_count
FROM advancedbehavior a
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind
